canada.title: Widow tells court she was reviving fallen Edmonton officer when she realized her husband was also shot
canada.summary: Paramedic Ashley Ryan said she was trying to revive one of two Edmonton police officers who had been shot when she realized the other victim was her husband. She recounted the traumatic moment at a sentencing hearing Tuesday for the man who supplied the shooter's rifle.

canada.title: Connor Hellebuyck tells media online death threats, family played roles in trade demand
canada.summary: Connor Hellebuyck says online death threats and his family were major factors in his Winnipeg trade demand.

canada.title: Carney government actively involved in talks leading to Stellantis plant sale: sources
canada.summary: The federal government was actively and intensively part of discussions that ended in the agreement to sell a Stellantis car assembly plant to Canadian armoured vehicle manufacturer Roshel, according to three sources with direct knowledge of the talks.

canada.title: 90-year-old veteran selling poppies says he was ‘harassed’ by Montreal metro security
canada.summary: 90-year-old Carl Andersen has been selling poppies in the Montreal metro since 2007, but he says he recently ran into a bit of an obstacle.

canada.title: Defendant in defamation trial says she believed Steven Galloway's accuser
canada.summary: A defendant in Steven Galloway's defamation lawsuit has testified how unproven allegations of rape and sexual assault against the author and writing professor came to light in late 2015 against a backdrop of criticism over how Galloway's employer, the University of British Columbia, was handling such complaints.

canada.title: Supreme Court of Canada upholds woman's conviction for dangerous driving death in Yellowknife
canada.summary: Hannah Lafferty was found guilty last year by the N.W.T. Supreme Court for causing the death of Germaine Mantla. The Supreme Court of Canada has dismissed an appeal of her conviction.

canada.title: Data centre proponent says they'll take no public money
canada.summary: Officials with the company pitching an $8-billion data centre campus in Nova Scotia have committed in writing that they will not ask for or take any government money.

canada.title: Mixed reaction in Yukon to the latest federal budget
canada.summary: The budget tabled last week includes promised investments in Yukon's energy grid, as well as a critical minerals strategy and a top-up of a grocery benefit.

canada.title: More than 250 mm of rain forecast for parts of B.C. as storm makes landfall
canada.summary: The B.C. River Forecast Centre has issued flood watches for the South Coast, Vancouver Island and river basins in the Central Coast and Fraser Valley.

canada.title: Prince Albert man arrested in connection with Rose Valley homicide
canada.summary: A man who was wanted for second-degree murder has been arrested in Regina. Steven Kishayinew, 58, was wanted in connection with the death of 66-year-old Willard Buckle of Rose Valley.

canada.title: From the battlefield to barriers at home: Remembering Indigenous veterans in Yellowknife
canada.summary: A Remembrance Day ceremony in Yellowknife honoured First Nations, Inuit and Métis Peoples who fought for Canada in war time.

canada.title: Wartime mystery solved as divers find wreck of ship torpedoed by German U-boat
canada.summary: The steamboat was heading from Barbados to New Brunswick in December 1944 when it was torpedoed by a German U-boat. Its wreckage was found this year.

canada.title: Quebec won't bail out CF Montreal, premier says, after news that owner will sell team
canada.summary: The government won't simply provide subsidies, Premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon said on Tuesday, but he is open to studying proposals as owner Joey Saputo begins the process of selling the Major League Soccer club.

canada.title: N.S. group apologizes for including woman convicted in a brutal killing on a panel
canada.summary: The Elizabeth Fry Society of Mainland Nova Scotia is apologizing after it hosted a panel discussion on violence that featured Marissa Shephard. Shephard was sentenced to 12 years in jail after she pleaded guilty to manslaughter and arson in the death of Baylee Wylie.

canada.title: Ontario appoints 8 new regional chairs after controversial rule change lets minister hand-pick appointees
canada.summary: Ontario's municipal affairs minister has appointed eight regional heads of council following a controversial legislative change that let the Ford government hand-pick appointees who otherwise would have been elected to their position.

canada.title: What's open and closed on Remembrance Day in Winnipeg
canada.summary: Some businesses, services and organizations will be closed or operating at reduced hours for Remembrance Day on Wednesday. Here's a look at what's open and closed in Winnipeg.

canada.title: Halifax man charged for allegedly spiking woman's drink at downtown bar
canada.summary: Police arrived at Durty Nelly's Irish Pub on Argyle Street early Saturday morning and found an unresponsive woman who had become ill after consuming a drink that a man was seen giving her.

canada.title: ‘Things will never be the same’: Wainwright prepares for Remembrance Day after fire
canada.summary: The Alberta town of Wainwright is gearing up for what could be the most solemn Remembrance Day in its recent history, says Mayor Bruce Pugh.

lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

The federal government was actively and intensively part of discussions that ended in the agreement to sell a Stellantis car assembly plant to Canadian armoured vehicle manufacturer Roshel, according to three sources with direct knowledge of the talks, The Canadian Press reports.
Tax changes and benefits you may have missed in Budget 2026, CP24 reports.
Firefighters were called to a fire in rural eastern Ontario that damaged three barns and a home in Bonnechere Valley Township, The Canadian Press reports.
US House Republicans block Pete Hegseth impeachment effort, Al Jazeera reports.

One of America’s most storied political dynasties — the Kennedy family — is joining a lawsuit against the Trump administration to block construction of the president’s 250-foot triumphal arch, The Canadian Press reports.
Republican Maria Elvira Salazar wins reelection to U.S. House in Florida’s 27th Congressional District, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
